vision: A unified dashboard that gives a solo founder command-center visibility over every AI-assisted workstream of the startup — tasks, architecture, agents, and outreach — in one dense, no-nonsense interface.
current_priorities: Ship the six-tab Mission Control dashboard reading from project_state.json
Wire up Vercel deployment for the mission-control app
Validate the dashboard renders correctly with empty and populated data

architecture_decisions.decision: Use Vite + React instead of Create React App
architecture_decisions.rationale: CRA is unmaintained; Vite gives faster dev server startup and build times for a single-page dashboard.

architecture_decisions.decision: Read project_state.json via fetch from /public instead of static import
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the dashboard read-only and lets the JSON file be edited without a rebuild during Week 1.
All state lives in a single JSON file; a backend can be introduced later once write functionality is needed.
